one_liner: Meta's advertising platform (Facebook/Instagram Ads); the Marketing API lets developers manage ad campaigns, audiences, and insights.

auth.evidence_quote: If your app is managing other people's ad accounts, you need advanced access to the ads_read and/or ads_management permissions.
auth.notes: Standard Meta Graph API OAuth2 access-token flow.

access.evidence_quote: Advanced access must be approved through the App Review process on an individual permission and feature basis.
access.notes: Basic access to your own ad account is self-serve; managing other people's ad accounts (third-party use case) requires App Review-approved Advanced Access, and apps must maintain call-volume/error-rate thresholds to keep it.

api.evidence_quote: Advanced access must be approved through the App Review process on an individual permission and feature basis.
api.notes: Marketing API has a very large resource/endpoint surface (campaigns, ad sets, ads, insights, etc.), well over 100. Did not verify official MCP server within call budget.

verdict.rationale: Free OAuth2 developer access works for a developer's own ad account immediately, but acting on other users' ad accounts requires Meta App Review approval of ads_management/ads_read.
